data.name: Asheel
data.gender_notes: Asheel is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Asheel is derived from the Arabic word 'Ashshilah' which means 'lion cub'. It is a unique and powerful name with a gentle and calming meaning. It is a perfect name for a child who is strong, yet gentle. The name Asheel carries the meaning “Lion Cub” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Asheel usually hope their child will grow to embody lion cub and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Asheel represents the purity and innocence of a young lion. It is a reminder of the strength and courage that lies within us all, even in the most gentle and meek of us. It is a name that inspires us to be strong in our faith and gentle in our actions.
data.etymology: Asheel belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lion Cub.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Asheel total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_arabic.name: أشيل
in_arabic.meaning: اسم مشتق من أَشيل يعني الشديد الصبر أو الحليم
in_arabic.long_meaning: أشيل هو اسم علم مذكر من أصل عربي، مشتق من الفعل أَشيل والذي يعني الشديد الصبر أو الحليم. يوحي الاسم بالصبر والتحمل والقدرة على مواجهة التحديات. وقد ورد في بعض التفاسير أنه من الأسماء التي تعبر عن الصفات الحميدة مثل الحلم والصبر.

in_hindi.name: अशील
in_hindi.meaning: अशील नाम का अर्थ है धैर्यवान या सहनशील व्यक्ति
in_hindi.long_meaning: अशील एक अरबी मूल का पुल्लिंग नाम है, जिसका अर्थ है धैर्यवान या सहनशील व्यक्ति। यह नाम धैर्य, सहनशीलता और चुनौतियों का सामना करने की क्षमता का प्रतीक है। भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में, यह नाम उन गुणों का प्रतिनिधित्व करता है जो एक मुस्लिम को अपने दैनिक जीवन में अपनाना चाहिए, जैसे कि धैर्य और सहनशीलता।

in_english.name: Asheel
in_english.meaning: Derived from Arabic, Asheel means patient, tolerant, or steadfast
in_english.long_meaning: Asheel is a masculine name with roots in Arabic etymology. It is derived from the Arabic term 'ashila,' which means to be patient or tolerant. The name signifies an individual who embodies qualities of endurance, calmness, and resilience. In Islamic tradition, these attributes are highly valued as they reflect the character of a believer. Historically, the name Asheel has been used across various Muslim cultures to denote someone with a strong and steadfast personality.
